scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rumireach/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @rumireach/api" "npm run dev -w @rumireach/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rumireach/shared && npm run build -w @rumireach/api && npm run build -w @rumireach/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @rumireach/shared && npm run typecheck -w @rumireach/api && npm run typecheck -w @rumireach/web
